label: SIMULATED glutamate sign rules with the adaptation sweep, male nerve cord

D0_silent_without_drive.test: no spikes in any of the twelve pools in any no-drive trial (selected cell)

D1_the_walking_command_makes_a_rhythm.test: median rhythmicity of the L1 flexor pool under forward walking >= 0.3 and above the grooming median

D2_antagonists_alternate.test: median circular distance of phase(L1 flexor -> L1 extensor) from 0.5 <= 0.15

D3_left_and_right_alternate.test: median circular distance of phase(L1 flexor -> R1 flexor) from 0.5 <= 0.15

D4_a_tripod.test: median circular distance of phase(L1 -> L2 flexor) from 0.5 <= 0.15 and of phase(L1 -> L3 flexor) from 0 <= 0.15

D5_the_coordination_comes_from_the_wirin.test: the intact cord passes at least one of D2-D4, and the rewired cord passes fewer of D2-D4 than the intact cord

D6_a_fly_like_step_period.test: median period of the L1 flexor rhythm under forward walking between 60 ms (Mendes et al. 2013) and 200 ms (our bound)
